prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final production Windows desktop application icon for Android DevKit, an Android developer workbench managing devices, emulators, SDKs, APKs and logs. One finished icon only.
Primary request: redesign the existing phone-with-terminal concept into a polished, distinctive, restrained professional app icon matching an established forest-green desktop UI. This is an application icon asset, not a presentation or mockup.
Subject: a single bold ivory geometric smartphone-outline mark with gently rounded corners, integrating a clear terminal chevron and short horizontal underscore inside its display. The silhouette should combine mobile development and a command console into one cohesive, optically centered emblem. One phone only, one chevron, one underscore. No Android robot. No lettering.
Scene/backdrop: the mark sits on one premium rounded-square forest-green tile. Outside this tile is truly transparent alpha. Tile nearly fills the square canvas with a modest transparent safety margin. Tile color close to #24694B / #185D48 with an extremely subtle smooth emerald highlight toward the upper left, elegant and muted. Ivory mark close to #F4F8EF.
Style/medium: precise geometric vector-like graphic rendered as a high quality PNG, smooth clean edges, robust consistent strokes, strong small-size silhouette, mostly flat with barely perceptible depth on the tile. Calm professional desktop software identity. Not cute or illustrative.
Composition/framing: square 1:1 image, front facing orthographic, strictly centered, the phone emblem occupies roughly 63 percent of tile height with generous balanced internal space. App tile has softly rounded corners around 22 percent corner radius. Terminal shapes thick enough to read at 32 pixels. Strong contrast.
Constraints: exact single finished application icon on genuine transparent background, highest resolution square available, clean RGBA edges, ready to ship. No text, no wordmarks, no labels, no watermark, no extraneous symbols, no wrench, no gear, no circuitry, no robot, no multiple alternatives, no small decorative details, no glass, no chrome, no perspective, no mockup, no surrounding scenery, no visible checkerboard.
